init_model_rfsearch: initialize a PyTorch model with RFSearchHook to enable receptive field search via dilation rates
wrap_model_conv2d: wrap a PyTorch model's Conv2d layers with Conv2dRFSearchOp for searchable receptive field operations
set_model_dilation: set fixed dilation rates on a model's Conv2d layers from a pre-searched receptive field structure config
step_dilation_search: perform a dilation searching step on the model and save the updated search config to JSON
estimate_and_expand_rates: estimate and expand dilation rates for all BaseConvRFSearchOp modules in the model during search
